UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Stores user profile information and game state.

id.description: The user's unique ID, same as the document ID.

avatar.description: URL of the user's chosen avatar.

chosenScenario.description: URL of the user's chosen scenario for their custom station.

unlockedStations.description: An array of station IDs that the user has unlocked.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores individual user profiles and their game progress.
